verses.2: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.4: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.5: I will be as the dew unto
verses.6: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.7: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.9: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
